purpose: Teach: 開通/見出す/最優秀/難易/パケット/初版/定数/休止

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新道路開通に伴う警備計画を立てられますね
lines.en: The police department can create security plans for the new road opening, can't they?
lines.style: Light, affirming tone. Kenji is making conversational observations about police capabilities, almost thinking aloud. Steady, even pacing with slight upward lilt at the end of each line—inviting agreement without demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人像を捜査資料から見出す技術もお持ちですね
lines.en: And the police have the skill to identify suspects from investigation records, too.
lines.style: Same warm, collaborative rhythm. Continuing the thread of capabilities. Soft emphasis on 「技術」—respect for the competence. Not talking at someone, thinking with them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、最優秀警官の表彰式もありますね
lines.en: There's also an awards ceremony for the top-performing officers, isn't there?
lines.style: Tone stays steady and engaged. A lighter observation now—noticing the human side of the work. Still conversational, not rhetorical. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の難易を担当別に振り分けられますね
lines.en: And the assignments can be distributed based on investigation difficulty by department, right?
lines.style: Back to the practical side. Kenji's tone remains interested and even, acknowledging smart organizational thinking. Measured pacing. Respectful observation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ネット犯罪のパケット解析を強化されますね
lines.en: The cyber-crime division is strengthening their packet analysis capabilities now, aren't they?
lines.style: Kenji continues with the same collaborative warmth. Moving through topics like he's genuinely curious about how things work. No urgency—just engaged attention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪統計の初版報告書を更新されますね
lines.en: And the first edition of the crime statistics report is being updated regularly?
lines.style: Still even and warm. Kenji is weaving through these observations smoothly. Each line feels like part of a continuous thought about competence and care in the department.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、定数配置の見直しもされますね
lines.en: There's also a review of personnel placements underway?
lines.style: Same collaborative energy. Kenji keeps the tempo light and steady. These aren't demands or accusations—they're observations of work being done well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地下鉄の休止対応訓練もされますね
lines.en: And you've been running training drills for subway shutdowns too, haven't you?
lines.style: The tone shifts slightly warmer and closer here—more direct, like Kenji is acknowledging effort and care specifically. Still measured but with a touch more personal warmth underneath.
